First listed 2026-03-16 · episode or wrap

Mark Cuban on the Broken Drug Pricing System & How PBMs Really Work | The Real Eisman Playbook Ep 50

Mark Cuban explains Cost Plus, PBM incentives and direct employer healthcare, while Eisman explicitly adopts several conclusions in his closing. Concentration and specialty-drug markups have primary support. The summary conflates rebates reaching plans with PBMs retaining them; the claims that PBMs exist only in America and only Cost Plus publishes pharmacy prices are contradicted. Company savings, retaliation and healthcare reform claims largely lack matched causal evidence. Cuban’s cash position and flow-driven equity theory remain guest views.

YouTube · 2026-03-16 ↗Substack · 2026-03-16 ↗
Material drug-pricing critique has empirical support, but several adopted premises are overstated. No investment-return win is inferred from business-model praise. Regulatory allegations are distinguished from established universal causation.
